text:
maria: Quick proposal — surface "observed routing" signals in the Console and add an opt-in SDK field so we can show whether a request used an explicit route or was inferred by the routing layer. would help debugging cost spikes :eyes:
kevin: by "observed" you mean the route the runtime actually chose, not the client hint, right?
tess: yes. we get a lot of tickets where console shows Route A but app devs swore they used Route B. showing "inferred_vs_explicit" could cut down on these.
roman: from python sdk side — adding a header is trivial, but we should avoid accidentally changing routing behavior. need opt-in + clear fallback.
sarah: TS SDK same. suggestion: emit telemetry fields instead of changing routing headers by default: `observedRouting: { inferred: boolean, routeId: string, confidence: number }`. opt-in only.
maria: runtime plan: emit `route.observed` events with origin tag (runtime|client-opted) and a tiny payload: route_id, inferred, confidence. Console will join to traces.
roman: doc snippet for curl we can include:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-RW-Observed-OptIn: true" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
kevin: risk: customers might misread samples as global routing splits. need sampling and explicit UI language about coverage.
tess: propose default sample rate 0.5% per-tenant, configurable in Console -> Advanced Routing -> Observed Telemetry. show sample size and 95% CI on the tile.
sarah: telemetry bandwidth: keep payload tiny — short route ids and a numeric confidence. everything else uses existing trace ids.
ops: legal/privacy check: fine, but add retention defaults (30d) and an org-level opt-out. also audit when admins toggle this.
roman: backward compat: old SDKs won't send the opt-in header — runtime can still emit observed events at infra-level; Console will label those as "runtime-observed" vs "client-opted". we should surface both.
kevin: rollout plan: 1) internal lab-only capture for 2w; 2) SDK opt-in preview + docs; 3) 1% public sampling with Console banner; 4) full tenant opt-in toggle.
tess: ship an internal-only debug tile first so customers aren't confused.
maria: agreed. internal -> preview -> public. internal tile shows raw stream and a small correlate-to-trace tool.
sarah: SDK API suggestion: `client.configure({observedRouting: {enabled: boolean, sampleRate: number}})`. default off. update CHANGELOG and release notes.
roman: add a lint/warning in python SDK when observedRouting.enabled is true and RUN_ENV=production to avoid accidental enables.
kevin: sampling location debate: server-side sampling gives accurate denominators for capacity/billing signals; client-side is simpler across languages.
ops: prefer server-side sampling for accuracy, but allow client-side opt-in during preview. server honors tenant opt-out.
maria: console/Dashboard: add tile showing observed_route breakdown, sample size, confidence band, and flag for client-opted vs runtime-only points. Tess will mock.
tess: I'll post sketches in #design today.
kevin: action items: @roman & @sarah add SDK opt-in config PRs; @tess mock Console tile; @ops add retention/opt-out; @maria draft rollout docs and announcement.
devbot: canary deploy started for routing-observed-ingest on infra-canary-3 (build 2026.3.14-rc) :partyparrot:
maria: thanks — sync tomorrow after sketches.
kevin: +1
